Title: Azure AD Privileged Identity Management approval workflows is now available

Body.Content: This feature allows organizations to require approval within Azure AD Privileged Identity Management for any directory role or Global Administrator role requests, and also define the users who can approve or deny these access requests. All actions are audited. Approvers are automatically notified to view and approve pending requests, either individually or in bulk, via the Azure Portal or MS Graph APIs. To learn more, you can refer to the public preview blog post (feature is generally available) and get started with the documentation today!
